simple.meaning: מָוֶת (mâveth) is a Hebrew action word meaning “death (natural or violent); concretely, the dead , their place or state (hades); figuratively, pestilence , ruin.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 158 times in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 12 more, beginning at Genesis 21:16. The surrounding contexts include family, family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מָוֶת (H4194) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: מָוֶת (mâveth) / H4194 is traced through Genesis 21:16, Genesis 25:11, Genesis 26:18, Genesis 27:2 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H4194. maveth מָ֫וֶת 161 noun masculine Exod 10:17 death ; — absolute ׳מ Deut 19:6 +; מָֽ֫וְתָה Psa 116:15 ; construct מוֺת Gen 25:11 +; suffix מוֺתִו 27:2 +; plural construct מוֺהֵי Ezek 28:10 ; suffix בְּמֹתָיו Isa 53:9 ; — 1 death , opposed to life, Deut 30:15 , 19 ; 2Sam 15:21 ; ׳מ האדם כל the death of all men (that all go to) Num 16:29 (J), as distinguished from violent death; מ ׳יוֺם day of death Gen 27:2 (J) Judg 13:7 ; 1Sam 15:35 +; מ ׳שְׁנַת Isa 6:1 ; 14:28 ; מ ׳עד Num 35:25 , 28 , 32 ; Josh 20:6 (P), 1Kin 11:40 ; מ ׳לפני Gen 27:7 , 10 ; 50:16 (JE); מ ׳אחרי 26:18 (J), 25:11 ; Lev 16:1 ; Num 35:28 (P), Deut 31:27 , 29 (D) +; מ ׳בכור Job 18:13 firstborn of death (deadly disease); of flies Eccl 10:1 , unclean animals Lev 11:31-32 , (P). 2 death by violence as a penalty : מ ׳מִשְׁמַּט + לְ or בְּ person: a case of death to , or in a man, guilty of capital crime Deut 19:6 ; 21:22 ; Jer 26:11 , 16 ; מ ׳חֵטְא Deut 22:26 ; ׳מ ( י ) בנ 1Sam 20:31 ; 26:16 ; 2Sam 12:5 ; מ ׳אישׁ 19:29 ; מ ׳אנשׁי 1Kin 2:26 ; מ ׳מַלְאֲכֵי Prov 16:14 messengers of death ; במותָיו Isa 53:9 in his (martyr-) death (see Br MP 359 ). 3 state of death or place of death (|| שׁאול ) Isa 28:15 , 18 ; 38:18 ; Hosea 13:14 ; Hab 2:5 ; Psa 6:6 ; 49:15 ; Song 8:6 ; Prov 5:5 ; 7:27 ; (|| אבדון ) Job 28:22 ; מ ׳שׁערי gates of death Psa 9:14 ; 107:18 ; Job 38:17 .
